What's your return and refund policy?

Sent · 4:23 PM

Barkers AI Agent · AI

Barkers AI Agent · AI says:

Barkers’ return and refund policy varies depending on how you made your purchase:

Online orders: You may return items within 30 days of delivery for a change of mind. Returns are free with a prepaid courier label and can be made at a Barkers store or sent to the online returns centre.
In-store purchases: Returns for a full refund are accepted within 14 days of purchase. Between 14 and 30 days, you may receive an exchange or store credit instead.
Endless Aisle orders: These must be returned to a Barkers store and cannot use the online returns label.

Items must be in original condition, unwashed, and have all labels attached. Worn, washed, damaged, or altered items cannot be returned for change of mind. Barkers may decline returns that do not meet these conditions.

To return an item:

In store: Bring the item and proof of purchase to any Barkers store.
Online NZ orders: Use the returns form and prepaid label provided, and drop off at NZ Post or book a pickup. If you use your own postage, you will need to cover the cost.

Refunds are processed to the original payment method. Gift card purchases are refunded to the same card, and Barkers Dollars are returned to your account. Barkers coupons are non-refundable.

For faulty items, Barkers will repair, replace, refund, or offer store credit as required by the Consumer Guarantees Act. If you are unsure if an item is faulty, you can visit a store or contact Customer Care.

Returns are processed within 1 to 2 days of reaching the warehouse, with refunds taking a few business days to appear. Australian online returns may take up to 5 business days to process.

If you would like a summary for online orders, in-store purchases, or faulty items, please let me know.

Barkers AI Agent · AI

Barkers AI Agent · AI says:

Yes, Barkers offers a loyalty and rewards program called Barkers & Co, which is free to join online or in store.

How it works:

Three membership tiers: Silver, Gold, and Platinum, based on your annual spend.
Earn Barkers Dollars on eligible purchases; the rate depends on your tier.
Online orders earn rewards after dispatch, while in-store purchases are credited automatically.
Barkers Dollars and rewards can be used for future purchases, and your balance is visible in your account and at checkout.

Tier benefits include:

Silver: 1 Barkers Dollar per $20 on full-price items, plus sign-up and birthday rewards.
Gold: 2 Barkers Dollars per $20 on full-price, 1 per $20 on sale/outlet, yearly bonus, and larger birthday reward.
Platinum: Same earning as Gold, highest birthday reward, annual bonus, and free NZ shipping.

Please note:

Barkers Dollars and rewards cannot be used for gift cards.
Rewards have expiry dates and may not be refundable if an order is returned.
Barkers Dollars can be used during promotions, but rewards coupons are not valid on VIP days.

You can check your balance, rewards, and expiry dates in your Barkers & Co account or at checkout.
